text:
lina.prod: FYI I clicked a 'Sign contract' link from contracts@veridian.io in my inbox. It redirected me to our SSO, I authenticated, then it asked to authorize an app to 'read org admins' and to upload the signed copy to a vendor URL. Not sure if I actually granted anything. Link looked weird: `https://veridian-attachments.io/upload/abcd?kms_key=redwood-cmk-001`
sec-bot: Phish report received and ticket created (INC-2026-145). Security on-call notified.
mike.sec: @lina.prod thanks — please paste the raw email headers and the redirect chain. Also confirm whether you used corp VPN or personal network.
lina.prod: Pasted raw header snippet: `From: contracts@veridian.io; Subject: Please sign: Redwood agreement`
Redirect chain I observed: `inbox link -> login.redwood.com/sso?app=veridian -> oauth.redirect/?state=..&token=eyJ.. -> https://veridian-attachments.io/upload/abcd?kms_key=redwood-cmk-001`
sara.it: If you granted OAuth consent, please go to https://login.redwood.com/account/apps and revoke the "Veridian Contracts" app immediately, and log out of all sessions. Also please forward the original message to security@redwood.com.
josh.soc: I'm checking SSO logs for Lina's sign-in (around ts 1976543209). Found token exchange from IP 3.120.45.12 (us-west-2). Starting a session correlation and EDR check on Lina's workstation.
mike.sec: Containment plan: 1) Lina revoke app + logout (done), 2) we will block vendor domain at email gateway and WAF, 3) rotate any exposed service credentials if we see cross-account access. @anel.kms please check KMS audit logs for any CreateGrant/Decrypt activity related to alias `redwood-cmk-001`.
lina.prod: Done: revoked app, logged out, changed password, and forwarded the email to security@redwood.com.
josh.soc: Sandbox results: the upload endpoint attempts to POST to an external S3-compatible bucket; the page includes a parameter `kms_key=redwood-cmk-001` embedded in the form action. Domain `veridian-attachments.io` was registered yesterday. EDR shows no file uploads from Lina's host. No lateral activity detected.
anel.kms: Checking KMS logs now — no CreateGrant/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls for alias `redwood-cmk-001` from external IPs in the last 48h. KMS policy review queue notified. We will not rotate the CMK immediately but will flag for audit if any symbols of misuse appear.
mike.sec: Good. It looks like the attacker tried to social-engineer users into consigning files to their bucket and luring OAuth consent to read org metadata. Even though a `kms_key` param was present, KMS cannot be used by external buckets without explicit grants. Action items: 
• mike.sec: draft company-wide reminder about OAuth consent and untrusted signing workflows (due EOD).
• sara.it: add `veridian-attachments.io` and related domains to email/WAF blocklists (ASAP).
• anel.kms: run a KMS naming/alias leak report and confirm no sensitive aliases are exposed in external communications (48h).
• josh.soc: finish EDR sweep for Lina and check for any suspicious outbound S3 PUTs (24h).

lina.prod: Thanks all — I feel OK but will ping if anything odd shows up. I also put a calendar reminder to check my sessions later :slightly_smiling_face:
mike.sec: :thumbsup: We'll close the incident after the follow-ups unless new evidence appears. Posting a short phish-awareness blurb to #general and adding this vector to our phishing exercise list.
sec-bot: Ticket INC-2026-145 status updated: triage complete, containment in progress, owner mike.sec.
